251013 | 📰 ARTICLE 

"TREASURE, truly a performance artist of a different kind… A perfect 'paradise'"

The group TREASURE perfectly proved on stage why they are called 'performance artists'. It was a moment that made the hearts of the TREASURE makers (fandom name) beat powerfully with a solid live performance that dominated the concert hall, explosive energy that overflowed, and fully matured stage skills.

They showed off their diverse charms across genres, including new songs from their third mini-album [Love Pulse] with a retro sound, emotional ballads, and refreshing dance tracks. The unit stages, in particular, captivated the audience’s eyes and ears with variations that differentiated them from their previous performances, doubling the freshness.

Complete performance + high-quality production… A synergy that satisfied all five senses Treasure's performance, which was continuously upgraded without limits, was the absolute best. Their unwavering vocals and rap, and captivating expressiveness, evoked admiration, and their sweeping, powerful performance and even more refined stage manners provided thrills at every moment.

The synergy with the performance production also shone. The stage design that further highlighted Treasure's performance, along with LED lights that added to the splendidness, and special effects such as fire pillars and gunpowder, all came together to maximize the immersion. Furthermore, the live band sound that hit hard in the ears and the synchronized choreography with the dancers breathed life into their musical world.

The Treasure Maker responded with a wave of swaying blue light sticks. TREASURE said, "We are happiest when we perform in front of our fans and enjoy ourselves together. We are so grateful to our fans for their love, and we will continue to become great TREASURE."
